source_message.text:
Current status
\- the site layout has been completely restored
\- Wordfence security has been set up
\- malware was cleared from around 15 outdated plugins
\- every fake admin was removed

Please complete the following
\- the pages look fine, but I cannot confirm whether all of the private pages are functioning correctly.
\- test each contact form
\- change your admin password

What I still need
\- Search Console access for Oakbridge too, so I can handle the search engine cleanup

\-----

**Overall report**
\- Every page on the website was deleted on July 1st
\- Most of the 6000 posts were injected on May 3rd
\- There are indications of earlier, smaller-scale attacks dating back to 2025.
